obligations.title: Deliver Milestone 1: Landing Zone built, security-reviewed and handed over with design and operations documentation by 19 August 2026.
Deliver Milestone 2: Wave 1 workloads migrated, tested and in production with cutover report by 28 October 2026.
Deliver Milestone 3: Wave 2 migrated, with final migration report and knowledge transfer completed by 16 January 2027.
Hold governance meetings at a frequency agreed by the project managers to review progress, risks and issues.
Appoint a project manager as primary point of contact.
Appoint a project sponsor and a technical lead with day-to-day decision authority.
Comply with Customer's notified reasonable security and site policies.
Provide an accurate inventory of in-scope workloads and dependencies before planning of each wave begins.
Maintain appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect Customer Data.
On expiry or termination, deliver completed and in-progress Deliverables and return Customer Data and Confidential Information.
